an8.11:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā verañjāyaṃ viharati nalerupucimanda mūle
an8.11:1.3: atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an8.11:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho verañjo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.11:2.2: na samaṇo gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayoanuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetīti
an8.11:2.4: nahi bhavaṃ gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayoanuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti,
an8.11:2.6: nāhaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇa, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yamahaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ vā paccuṭṭheyyaṃ vā āsanena vā nimanteyyaṃ.
an8.11:2.7: yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa, tathāgato abhivādeyya vā paccuṭṭheyya vā āsanena vā nimanteyya muddhāpi tassa vipateyyāti.
an8.11:3.2: atthi khvesa brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:3.4: ye te brāhmaṇa, rūparasā saddarasā gandharasā rasarasā poṭṭhabbarasā te tathāgatassa pahīnā, ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
an8.11:3.5: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammāvadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:3.6: arasarūpo samaṇo gotamo’ti. no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:4.2: atthi khvesa brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya-
an8.11:4.4: ye te brāhmaṇa, rūpabhogā saddabhogā gandhabhogā rasabhogā poṭṭhabbabhogā te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
an8.11:4.5: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo yena pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:4.6: nibbhogo samaṇo gotamoti, no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:5.2: atthi khvesa brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.11:5.4: hi brāhmaṇa, akiriyaṃ vadāmi kāyaduccaritassa vacīduccaritassa manoduccaritassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ akiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an8.11:5.5: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:5.6: akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamoti. no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:6.2: atthi khvesa brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:6.4: hi brāhmaṇa, ucchedaṃ vadāmi rāgassa dosassa mohassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmi.
an8.11:6.5: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:6.6: ucchedavādo samaṇo gotamo’ ti, no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:7.2: atthi khvesa brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:7.4: ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa, jigucchāmi kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā jigucchāmi,
an8.11:7.5: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.11:7.6: ‘jegucchī samaṇo gotamo’ti, no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:8.2: atthi khvesa brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.11:8.4: hi brāhmaṇa, vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi rāgassa dosassa mohassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi.
an8.11:8.5: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:8.6: ‘venayiko samaṇo gotamo’ ti, no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:9.2: atthi khvesa brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:9.4: tapanīyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, pāpake akusale dhamme vadāmi kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ,
an8.11:9.5: yassa kho brāhmaṇa, tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tamahaṃ tapassī’ti vadāmi,
an8.11:9.6: tathāgatassa kho brāhmaṇa, tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
an8.11:9.7: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:9.8: ‘tapassī samaṇo gotamo’ti, no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:10.2: atthi khvesa brāhmaṇa, pariyāye, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.11:10.4: yassa kho brāhmaṇa, āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tamahaṃ apagabbhoti vadāmi
an8.11:10.5: tathāgatassa kho brāhmaṇa, āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
an8.11:10.6: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena, sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.11:10.7: ‘apagabbho samaṇo gotamo’ ti no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:11.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā,
an8.11:11.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni,
an8.11:11.3: yo nu kho tesaṃ kukkuṭacchāpakānaṃ paṭhamataraṃ pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyya, kinti svāssa vacanīyo jeṭṭho vā kaṇiṭṭho vāti?
an8.11:11.4: jeṭṭhotissa bho gotama, vacanīyo, so hi tesaṃ jeṭṭho hotī’ti.
an8.11:12.1: evameva kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, avijjāgatāya pajāya aṇḍabhutāya, pariyonaddhāya avijjaṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā ekova loke anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho,
an8.11:12.2: ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa jeṭṭho seṭṭho lokassa.
an8.11:13.1: āraddhaṃ kho pana me brāhmaṇa, viriyaṃ ahosi asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā pati asammuṭṭhā. passaddho kāyo asāraddho; samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
an8.11:13.2: so kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an8.11:13.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi,
an8.11:13.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharāmi. sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti. ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an8.11:13.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
an8.11:14.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
an8.11:14.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
an8.11:15.1: ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa, rattiyā paṭhame yāme paṭhamā vijjā adhigatā
an8.11:15.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
an8.11:15.3: ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa, paṭhamā abhinibbhidā ahosi kukkuṭacchāpakasseva aṇḍakosamhā.
an8.11:16.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
an8.11:16.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne uppajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi …pe…
an8.11:17.1: ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa, rattiyā majjhime yāme dutiyā vijjā adhigatā,
an8.11:17.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato,
an8.11:17.3: ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa, dutiyā abhinibbhidā ahosi. kukkuṭacchāpakasseva aṇḍakosamhā.
an8.11:18.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ,
an8.11:18.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
an8.11:18.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
an8.11:18.4: tassa me evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha, bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha, diṭṭhāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha, avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha.
an8.11:18.6: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsiṃ.
an8.11:19.1: ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa, rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā,
an8.11:19.2: avijjā vihatā, vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
an8.11:19.3: ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa, tatiyā abhinibbhidā ahosi kukkuṭacchāpakasseva aṇḍakosambhāti.
an8.11:20.1: evaṃ vutte verañjo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.11:20.2: jeṭṭho bhavaṃ gotamo, seṭṭho bhavaṃ gotamo,
an8.11:20.3: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
an8.11:20.6: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
